result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but a few horizontal-scroll and fixed-navigation areas look visually rough or partially clipped.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off abruptly on the right side. The third restaurant card image and title are only partially visible, which can look broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel treatment such as proper right padding, scroll snapping, a fade/peek pattern, or ensure visible cards fit cleanly within the viewport.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially visible blank-looking pill at the far right edge after 'Healthy'. This looks like an accidental clipped UI element.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal padding or scroll positioning so the next chip is either meaningfully visible with text or hidden more cleanly.

issues.description: The bottom navigation overlaps the feed area, causing the lower restaurant card to be visibly cut off at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
